spec.goal: Execute XY-149 by fixing the screenshot-mode repaint stall cluster so the live RGB HUD warms up without cursor movement and hovered-window selection flow keeps animating while the same target remains hovered.
success_criteria: A valid saved plan/1 artifact exists for XY-149 and is used as the execution authority for this lane.
Entering screenshot mode no longer leaves the live RGB HUD stuck in its placeholder state until a later cursor move.
Hovered-window selection flow keeps repainting while the same live hover target remains active, so the glow animation no longer freezes on its first frame.
The fix stays scoped to screenshot-mode repaint and sampling behavior without widening unrelated overlay redraw ownership.
Focused regression tests cover the startup live-sample warmup path and hovered-window repaint-active contract.
Fresh verification evidence shows the touched rsnap-overlay surface still passes after the fix.
constraints: Keep the implementation scoped to the screenshot-mode repaint family in rsnap-overlay unless execution proves a tighter dependency.
Do not widen unrelated frozen-mode, toolbar, or scroll-capture redraw policy while fixing the live screenshot regressions.
Use repo-native Rust verification on the touched overlay scope before claiming completion.

triggers: The startup RGB warmup stall requires a broader live-frame stream lifecycle rewrite rather than local request bookkeeping changes.
Keeping hovered-window selection flow animated requires a wider global repaint loop instead of a bounded active-monitor repaint condition.
Targeted verification exposes a broader overlay event-loop or redraw architecture issue that cannot be solved within the screenshot-mode repaint lane.

evidence: Task 1 evidence: the startup RGB stall and hovered-window glow freeze were adjacent no-input repaint bugs in the same live overlay family, not one shared flag. Startup warmup stalled because the macOS synchronous latest-frame path marked a request as latest but never marked it applied when no sample was available, which blocked idle retries until a later cursor move. Hover animation froze because maybe_keep_selection_flow_repaint() only treated drag rectangles as live repaint-active, even though the render path also draws animated selection flow for hovered_window_rect.

Task 2 outcome: packages/rsnap-overlay/src/overlay.rs now centralizes live-sample pending bookkeeping through live_sample_request_pending()/note_live_cursor_sample_request_started() and explicitly finishes synchronous macOS live-sample attempts, so a startup no-sample miss no longer leaves a phantom pending request behind.

Task 3 outcome: live_overlay_selection_flow_repaint_active() now stays active for a hovered live window on the active monitor as well as for drag rectangles, which keeps the hovered-window selection flow requesting repaint instead of freezing on its first frame.
Task 4 outcome: added focused regression tests covering hovered-window repaint activation and the fact that synchronous live-sample attempts do not remain pending after a no-sample miss.
